validation.denseStress: 5 cycles, 10000 membership moves plus 2512 fragmented moves

runNotes.ordinaryBatchProfile: Early TimerFire spans can include later validation; only bounded layout/style subevents were used for diagnosis.
runNotes.redundantPointerCapture: CreatingState already captures later in dispatch; this is not an independent capture intervention.
runNotes.cursorCoverInterrupted: Incomplete run; includes deliberate browser-close failure and all recoverable completed rows. Not a full acceptance result.
runNotes.dragTrace: Diagnostic tracing has overhead. It does not replace any failed formal drag sample.
